description: A Drupal module class for processing text with formatting, caching, and rendering capabilities.

classes.name: TextProcessed
classes.description: A computed property class for processing text with a format, implementing caching and rendering logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TextProcessed object, ensuring 'text source' setting is provided.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns processed and formatted text as FilteredMarkup, rendering if necessary.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the processed text value and notifies parent of changes if applicable.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Retrieves cache tags related to the processed text.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Retrieves cache contexts related to the processed text.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Retrieves cache max age for the processed text.

methods.name: getRenderer
methods.description: Provides the renderer service used for rendering in isolation.
